If it turns out to be a Policy — it creates or redesigns the governance of an

Reasoning does not belong in this file. Put it in a companion rationale.md, or a
future reader will cite your argument as law.

Then delete this comment.

TIER — choose it, do not just leave A:
    A   48 hours, and it passes unless somebody objects
    B   a stated period under seven days, same lazy consensus
    C   seven days or more, and an actual vote: simple majority of those
        voting, quorum of 7
You may enter at any tier. One stated objection moves a proposal up a tier and
it never moves back down, so entering at A costs nothing if you are wrong. If
you choose B, state the number of days in the pull request.

STATUS — live, experimental, or archived. Constitution §1's own three words.

IF THIS EXPIRES, say so in a line of its own, flush to the left margin, below
this comment. It states the instant twice: in words, for whoever is reading the
rule, and as a timestamp in backticks, which is what the dashboard reads. A
check compares the two and warns if they disagree — a wrong weekday, two
different dates, or the wrong offset for the time of year. Like this, without
the leading spaces:

  **Ends:** 23:59 UK time, Monday 30 November 2026 (`2026-11-30T23:59:00+00:00`) — reason

The United Kingdom is on British Summer Time from late March to late October,
so a summer date is +01:00 and a winter one is +00:00.
